ideas.note: Fair value of the coin-margined book is the USDT close. The finished coin-margined close was at least five basis points above that fair value. The next coin-margined open is sold and bought back sixteen days later. The other trade sells the coin-margined book for sixteen days when that premium is absent. Same prices, same side, the edge turned off. One leg. Funding cash is not added. The null is not an unconditional hold and it is not the opposite side.
